title: Team-name normalization merges Atletico Mineiro with Athletico Paranaense
evidence: soccer.go:185 norm() rewrites "atletico"->"athletico" after stripping 2-char state suffixes (soccer.go:181), so atletico-mg and athletico-pr collapse to one standings key; factual gate _factual.json confirms 19 of 20 clubs in 2019 Serie A (factual_accuracy=0.5)
suggestion: Do not fold atletico->athletico; key standings on full club identity (name + state suffix) so the two clubs stay distinct
